title: Special counsel costs defending a fire captain
summary: Resolution 26-131 would raise the cap on special counsel spending by $250,000, to $450,000 in total. The special counsel represents Captain Scott Martin in a lawsuit filed by Chelsea Evans. A deputy corporation counsel said state law requires defending firefighters sued for acts done on duty.
